messages:
kevin: Quick pitch 5 mini "Lightning Labs" sessions to drive traffic to the refkit repo and collect bench runs. goal: 40 installs, 30 bench submits. 1-week sprint.
maya: neat. idea: 5 daily micro-tutorials (15-20m each) + a leaderboard. low-friction bench script and pasteable results URL.
alex: agree. propose tutorials: 1) setup, 2) request routing, 3) batching tips, 4) quantize cheat, 5) deploy demo (cpu fallback).
sophia: landing form minimum: name,email,github,bench_url,utm. HubSpot tag = refkit_lightning_2405. trigger nurture for submitters.
kevin: timeline: Mon assets ready, Tue landing + repo live, Wed open signups, daily drip, next Mon demo recap webinar.
maya: social plan: 7 posts (launch, 5 daily prompts, recap). A/B CTA: "Build a refapp" vs "Run a quick benchmark".
alex: infra: I'll add `run_bench.py` with `--cpu` and a `results.json` schema. CLI: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-1b --seq 256 --batch 4`.
sophia: prizes modest: sticker set + blog highlight. KPI: bench submissions first.
cardinal-bot: Reminder: staging page must be live at 1715220000 for QA.
kevin: owners: kevin=owner, alex=tech, maya=social, sophia=landing. quick sync Fri 9am PT. Keep replies here only.
